description: Instituto Nacional de Estadística: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estadística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estadística. The listing groups 10 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Movimiento de trenes. TF (Identificador API: 49357); Movimiento de trenes. TF (Identificador API: 24365); Transporte por ferrocarril (Grupos 491, 492 CNAE-2009): por desglose d. Formats seen: HTML, PC-AXIS, CSV, JSON, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.ine.es/aviso_legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
